themes_detail.label: Street & Sidewalk Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints in East New York/Cypress Hills spiked to 56 complaints THIS WEEK, a 421% increase from the 10.8 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.66), suggesting a sudden onset of construction, street vending, or commercial activity disrupting residents.
evidence: 56 noise-street/sidewalk complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
421% spike with z-score of 6.66 (statistically significant high-severity anomaly)
No corresponding Reddit or news coverage suggests this may be unreported locally
reporting_angles: Ground-truth what triggered the noise spike this week—construction site, street vendor congregation, nightlife venue expansion, or new commercial activity?
Interview residents on Pitkin Ave, Liberty Ave, or Jamaica Ave to document the disturbance and its timing

themes_detail.label: Elevator Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints in the district jumped to 7 this week, a 700% increase from the 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.82), indicating a systemic failure in building elevator maintenance or repair response across multiple residential buildings.
evidence: 7 elevator complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Aligns with ongoing heat/hot water complaints (3,359 total over 90 days), suggesting building infrastructure distress
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings filed multiple elevator complaints and interview residents about wait times and accessibility impacts for elderly and disabled residents
Check whether a single elevator repair company or inspector shortage is causing bottlenecks

themes_detail.label: Dead/Dying Tree Spike & Tree Requests
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints surged to 4 THIS WEEK (967% above the 0.4 weekly baseline, z-score: 7.49), while tree requests simultaneously jumped to 3 (2300% above baseline), suggesting rapid tree die-off and urgent resident demand for street tree replacement in response.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% spike, z-score: 7.49)
3 new tree requests THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Repeated budget request for 'improve access to a park or amenity' suggests tree canopy/green space is a chronic district concern
reporting_angles: Walk the district to identify which blocks are losing trees and whether drought, disease, or neglect is responsible
Interview Parks Dept about tree inspection frequency and whether maintenance backlogs are contributing to tree die-off

themes_detail.label: Lot Condition & Vacant Property Issue
themes_detail.summary: Lot condition complaints jumped to 3 THIS WEEK, a 2300% spike from the 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.69), indicating the emergence of new or deteriorating vacant properties, illegal dumping, or overgrown lots that pose blight and safety concerns.
evidence: 3 lot condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Unsanitary condition complaints remain elevated overall (817 over 90 days)
Baobab Village and other development proposals in ULURP pipeline suggest land assembly activity may be exposing previously abandoned properties
reporting_angles: Identify which specific lots were flagged this week and whether they are tied to active development projects or longstanding blight
Assess whether lot deterioration is accelerating due to real estate speculation ahead of rezoning (17-21 Wharton Place, Constellation CB5)

themes_detail.label: Street Light Outages Persist
themes_detail.summary: Street light complaints remained elevated at 31 complaints 3 weeks ago, representing a 222% increase from the 9.6 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.81), indicating ongoing infrastructure gaps in street lighting maintenance that affect pedestrian safety and quality of life.
evidence: 31 street light complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 9.6 weekly average (222% spike, z-score: 4.81)
Spike is 3 weeks old and not in this week's data, suggesting either resolution or data lag
Aligns with long-standing district infrastructure concerns in budget requests (no new plaza/street improvements funded)
reporting_angles: Follow up on whether the 31 complaints from 3 weeks ago have been resolved or are still dark blocks
Map the outages to identify whether a particular neighborhood section (e.g., Starrett City, Linden Blvd corridor) is disproportionately affected
